tunables.name: SCHEMA_VERSION
tunables.reason: format/era version stamp: the version a stored record, wire message or table was written at; changing it is a format change guarded by its own version test, not tuning

tunables.name: HALF
tunables.reason: one half: the centre of a span, a mathematical constant, not tuning

tunables.name: MILLI
tunables.reason: millimetres per metre: the enclosure pieces' offsets are rounded to a millimetre so the compiled rows are stable text, a unit conversion, not tuning

tunables.name: EPS
tunables.reason: a float guard on a ceiling so an exact multiple of the wall length does not add a piece: numeric hygiene, not tuning

tunables.name: HALF_TURN_DEG
tunables.reason: degrees in half a turn: a unit conversion, not tuning
